scenarios.name: main-phase-landfall-grants-combat
scenarios.why: A land enters under Moraug's controller during their main phase, satisfying the intervening condition and creating an additional combat phase after that phase.

scenarios.name: non-main-phase-landfall-no-combat-trigger
scenarios.why: The land enters during the end step, not a main phase, so the intervening condition is false and no additional-combat ability triggers.
